name: sl-ui-library
description: Find SL UI components with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Next.js exports. Adapt their palette and preserve source behavior.

interface.shortDescription: UI components for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Next.js.
interface.longDescription: Choose from 388 interactive components across ten categories, with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Next.js exports. Read real source, adapt its palette and integrate a complete package. React and Next.js adapters preserve the original controllers as isolated client widgets; meaningful widget SSR is not provided. Catalog and source files work offline. Optional catalog updates require a published channel and explicit opt-in.
defaultPrompt: Add a topic picker using my app's palette.
Build a compact project dialog for my app.
Choose suitable navigation for my dashboard.
